notes.title: 2025/09/10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]In preparation of our console release and due to a major score change in the latest ROM. We are going to reset all Leaderboards. 

[/p][h2]2025/09/10 Patch Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Localization fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Press Start Button" in Title screen in the ROMS to have a button overlay for Start Button instead of the word Start.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a version number in Extra. Representing the Frontends version.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix where Names in the leaderboard were not displaying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ROMS version number in uploaded Scores.[/p][/*][*][p]Limiting uploaded Scores to be only from Latest Patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix to Subtitles not working after view the Prologue twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix to Subtitles getting stuck if they are skipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Leaderboards for Challenge 1-6[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ROMS to be version 3.3.0[/p][/*][/list][h2]Earthion Version 3.3.0 Patch Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Stage 7 - The collision position for the boss's beam attack has been adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 8 - The hit collision for the first boss's (Neurocrawler) head has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]The prologue text has been adjusted: YK-IIA has been changed to YK-ⅡA (English and Portuguese versions)[/p][/*][*][p]A 1 million point bonus has been added when clearing the game without missing a shot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display error in which NOVA's damage was not shown[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 4 - Fixed unexpected glitch occurring during boss battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect stage designation in title demo[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo (Japanese version) (戦積 → 戦績)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues in the ending (Portuguese version)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the random playback frame count in the Music Player to the correct value[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the final boss wreckage bonus so it cannot be obtained after the player dies[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the countdown sequence to be easier to skip[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Earthion Patch Notes (August 4 2025)
notes.content: [h2]2025/8/4 Patch Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Updated Earthion game to Version 2.0.1 (which fixes in-game bugs)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Windows icon on program[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam Language detection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when using integer screen scale and reducing window size below 100% [/p][/*][*][p]Input system selection (Steam Input/Raw Input) setting is now preserved [/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard configuration has been refined [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Difficulty Achievements not being triggered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous audio issues [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Earthion Version 2.0.1 Patch Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue of subweapons becoming unusable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue of subweapons occasionally not displaying correctly [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue of game freezing after inputting password [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue of sound effects not playing after selecting Continue [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy bullets to be more easily visible [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted three pixels in the second half of Stage 2 [/p][/*][*][p]Start can now be pressed when selecting Continue[/p][/*][*][p]Can skip Countdown by pressing Start (Only in Automatic Mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 more Challenge Modes [/p][/*][/list]
